centralmgmtsoftware.text: miComs (COMS-PRO) Central Office Management | MiChoice Technology Systems Home › Products › miComs (COMS-PRO) miComs (COMS-PRO) Central Office Management Software COMS-PRO is the central nervous system of MiChoice deployments. It's the single data source that connects every cafeteria POS to the district central office — in real time, across the WAN, with bi-directional flow for F&R processing, meal accountability, and government reporting. Request a Demo ← All Products COMS-PRO District Office Lincoln Elementary Jefferson Middle Washington High School Roosevelt Elementary Real-Time · Bi-Directional · District-Wide miComs (COMS-PRO) Central Office · Real-Time · District-Wide Key Features Real-Time Bi-Directional Data COMS-PRO pushes and pulls data from every cafeteria POS across the district's WAN — automatically, continuously, without manual intervention. Centralized F&R Processing All free and reduced applications are processed at the district level in COMS-PRO and propagated in real time to every school POS. District-Wide Meal Accountability Complete accountability across every school, every cafeteria, every transaction — from a single central interface. Government Reporting Generates all required USDA and state-level reports directly from COMS-PRO — no manual data assembly from multiple systems. Common Data Source One database. All modules share it. No synchronization jobs. No data mismatches between systems. WAN Integration Designed for district-scale networks. Connects schools across the district's existing wide-area network infrastructure. The District Data Hub COMS-PRO serves as the focal point for all information flow throughout the MiChoice ecosystem. As an all-inclusive back office product, it provides the district child nutrition department with a common data source for every function — from F&R processing to meal accountability to government reporting. The system allows for bi-directional, real-time transfer of data between COMS-PRO and every MiChoice FAR-Apps and eMeal POS installation across the district's WAN. A status change at the central office is live at the serving line in minutes. A meal transaction at any school is visible at the central office immediately. COMS-PRO centralizes the entire workflow — application intake (via FAR-Apps and the online portal), determination, status assignment, and POS update — so that district staff manage the process from one system instead of coordinating across multiple schools and applications. COMS-PRO generates all required reports directly from its centralized database — no manual data collection from individual schools, no spreadsheet assembly, no last-minute scrambles. Audit trails are built in from day one. From application intake to determination to real-time POS update, the entire workflow runs automatically, reducing labor costs and maximizing federal funding. Eligibility Check 3 → POS Updated Real-Time All Sites 4 Labor Reduced Auto determination Max Funding NSLP compliant Full Audit Trail State/federal ready FAR-Apps · Automated Eligibility · Real-Time POS Updates miFAR (FAR-Apps) Automated Eligibility · Real-Time Updates · Full Audit Trail ⚡ Immediate Labor Reduction The entire application processing workflow becomes automated. Data entry and record keeping reduced to a minimum. 💰 Maximum Federal Funding Accurate eligibility processing ensures your district captures every dollar of federal reimbursement available. 📋 Complete Audit Trail Full compliance documentation maintained automatically — ready for state or federal audit at any time. Key Features End-to-End Automation From application receipt through determination through POS status update — the entire eligibility workflow runs without manual intervention. Real-Time POS Updates Eligibility status changes propagate to every cafeteria POS across the district in real time — no delays, no manual status updates at school sites. COMS-PRO Integration FAR-Apps and COMS-PRO share a common data source — eligibility data flows seamlessly into district meal accountability and government reporting. Online Application Intake Integrates with MiChoice's online F&R application portal — digital submissions process directly through FAR-Apps with no paper handling. NSLP Compliance Built to meet every National School Lunch Program requirement — determination criteria, verification procedures, and reporting obligations. Application Tracking Complete visibility into every application — received, in process, determined, pending verification. Nothing falls through the cracks. Notification Management Automated notification to families upon determination — approval, denial, and verification request letters generated by the system. The F&R Processing Challenge Free and reduced meal eligibility processing is one of the most labor-intensive administrative functions in school food service. Districts receive thousands of applications. Each must be reviewed, verified, determined, entered into the system, and communicated back to the family — with every step documented for potential audit. Without automation, this process consumes enormous staff time and creates significant risk of error — both in the determinations themselves and in the updates to the cafeteria serving line. A student with a pending determination who is incorrectly charged full price creates both financial and compliance problems. How FAR-Apps Solves It FAR-Apps automates the entire workflow. Applications enter through the online portal, flow through the determination logic, and update COMS-PRO and every cafeteria POS automatically. Staff manage exceptions and edge cases — the routine determinations happen without manual intervention. The result is an immediate and measurable reduction in administrative labor costs, while simultaneously reducing determination errors and improving the speed with which eligible students receive their benefits. Federal Funding Impact Every properly processed F&R application translates directly to federal reimbursement. Districts that process applications accurately and completely capture every dollar they're entitled to. FAR-Apps assures your district of maximum school lunch funding while maintaining a complete compliance audit trail — so a state or federal audit doesn't become a financial risk. onlinefreeandreducedapplications.title: Online F&R Applications | MiChoice Technology Systems
onlinefreeandreducedapplications.text: Online F&R Applications | MiChoice Technology Systems Home › Products › Online F&R Applications Online Portal Online Free & Reduced Application Portal Families apply for free and reduced meal benefits directly online — no paper, no drop-off, no scanning. Applications submit digitally into FAR-Apps for immediate processing, determination, and real-time POS update. Districts close the loop faster, capture more federal funding, and eliminate paper handling entirely. Request a Demo ← All Products mydistrict.org/fr-application Free & Reduced Meal Application Student Name Alex Johnson Grade 7th Household Size 4 members Annual Income $34,500 Benefit Program (SNAP/TANF) Yes — SNAP enrolled Submit Application → Submitted → FAR-Apps Digital Intake · Zero Paper · Instant Processing Online F&R Portal Digital Intake · Zero Paper · Instant to FAR-Apps How the Online Application Process Works 1 Family Visits Portal District-branded online application form → 2 Completes Application Household income, student info, benefits → 3 Submits Digitally Secure submission — no paper, no drop-off → 4 FAR-Apps Processes Auto-determination runs immediately → 5 Family Notified Approval or denial letter sent automatically ⚡ Faster Determinations Online submissions enter FAR-Apps immediately — no paper handling delay between application and processing. 📄 Zero Paper Handling No forms to collect, sort, scan, or file. The entire intake pipeline is digital from first submission. 💰 Capture More Benefits Easier applications mean higher participation rates — more eligible families complete the process and more federal funding flows to the district. Key Features District-Branded Portal Each district's online application portal is branded to match their identity — families see a familiar, trustworthy interface, not a generic third-party form. Direct FAR-Apps Integration Submitted applications flow directly into FAR-Apps for processing. No manual handoff, no re-entry — the digital submission is the intake record. Multi-Student Households A single application covers all students in the household. Families don't need to complete separate applications for each child. Application Status Tracking Families can check the status of their submitted application online — reducing status inquiry calls to district offices. Automated Notifications Determination letters — approval, denial, and verification requests — are generated and delivered automatically once FAR-Apps completes processing. NSLP Compliance Built In The application form captures every data element required by NSLP regulations — income documentation, household size, benefit certifications, and required disclosures. Secure Submission Applications are submitted over encrypted connections. Sensitive household income and benefit data is handled in compliance with applicable privacy requirements. Primary Application Channel Districts can offer the online portal as the primary application channel — paper remains available for households without internet access. The Paper Application Problem For decades, free and reduced meal applications meant paper — forms sent home in backpacks, returned crumpled and sometimes incomplete, collected at the school office, sorted, batched, and manually entered into the eligibility system. Every step in that chain is labor, every step introduces delay, and every step is an opportunity for an application to be lost, misread, or miskeyed. The online application portal eliminates every one of those steps. The family completes the form at home on any device. The submission is instant, complete, and already in the format FAR-Apps needs. The district receives a clean digital record the moment the family submits. Higher Participation, More Federal Funding Districts consistently find that easier application processes lead to higher participation from eligible families. When the barrier to applying is a paper form that has to be returned to school, families who are eligible but time-constrained often don't complete the process. When the application is online, available at any hour, completable in minutes, participation rates improve — and every additional properly processed application means additional federal reimbursement for the district. The FAR-Apps Connection The online portal is designed as the digital front end to FAR-Apps — not a standalone system. When a family submits online, the application flows directly into FAR-Apps' processing workflow. Determination runs. The result updates COMS-PRO and every cafeteria POS across the district in real time. The family receives notification. The entire cycle that once took days of paper handling now runs in hours — often same-day for completed applications. Secure Online Processing Payments are processed through RevTrak's encrypted, hosted payment platform — no card data is stored by the district. District-Branded Portal Each district gets a personalized web store under the mymealmoney.com umbrella — familiar and trustworthy for families. Automatic Daily Import A simple daily import process moves all online payments into MiChoice with no manual data entry required from district staff. Fund Accounting Reports RevTrak generates fund accounting reports that make reconciliation simple and efficient for district finance staff. Balance Visibility Parents can check their student's current balance before making a payment — informed parents, fewer low-balance surprises. Reduces Office Inquiries When parents can check balances and pay online, cafeteria offices field fewer "what's my child's balance?" phone calls. Proven Integration The RevTrak payment integration is maintained and supported end-to-end, giving districts a stable, hands-off payment pipeline. The Payment Collection Challenge Collecting meal account payments from families has historically been a friction-heavy process — cash sent with students, checks processed manually, balances updated by hand. Each of these touchpoints creates administrative work, increases error risk, and creates cash handling security exposure. Online meal payment solves all three. Parents pay digitally at their convenience. RevTrak handles the payment security. The daily automatic import into MiChoice eliminates manual processing. The result is less work for district staff, faster balance updates for students, and a more convenient experience for families. The RevTrak Integration MiChoice's online payment solution runs on RevTrak, a provider of credit and debit card solutions for K-12 schools. RevTrak's hosted platform handles cardholder data and payment security, so districts don't need to build or maintain their own payment security infrastructure. Fund Accounting and Reconciliation Online payments are easy to receive but can create reconciliation complexity if the reporting isn't designed for it. RevTrak's fund accounting reports are built specifically for school finance offices — making the reconciliation between collected payments and account postings straightforward and audit-friendly. Key Features Real-Time Balance Display Account balances displayed reflect the MiChoice system in real time — the same balance the cafeteria POS sees at the serving line. Transaction History Parents can review recent transactions — which meals were purchased, what they cost, and when payments were applied. Account transparency without requiring a call. Low-Balance Email Alerts Automated email notifications when a student's balance falls below a parent-set threshold — giving families time to top up before the account reaches zero. Multi-Student Households Parents with multiple students can check all of their children's accounts in a single session — no need to look up each student separately. No Staff Involvement Required Self-service balance retrieval means parents get the information they need without involving cafeteria or district office staff — freeing staff for operational priorities. Available Any Time The parent portal is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. No waiting until the cafeteria opens. No phone tag with office staff. Read-Only Access Account retrieval is a view-only function — balances and history are visible, but no changes can be made. Payments are handled separately through mymealmoney.com. Direct Path to Payment When a parent checks the balance and sees it's low, the portal links directly to mymealmoney.com — the district's RevTrak-powered online payment portal — to add funds immediately. Need to add funds? Online Meal Account Retrieval shows you the balance. To add money to a student's account, use the district's mymealmoney.com portal — secure online payments via credit or debit card, processed by RevTrak. Payments import automatically into MiChoice. No manual entry required. Online Meal Payments → The Balance Inquiry Problem In school cafeterias, one of the most common sources of office interruption is the parent balance inquiry — "What's my child's account balance?" It seems simple, but fielding those calls requires a staff member to stop what they're doing, look up the student, and read the balance. Across a district, these inquiries add up to a significant volume of low-value interruptions to operational staff. Online Meal Account Retrieval eliminates those calls. Parents check the balance themselves, online, at whatever hour is convenient for them. The cafeteria office doesn't get the call because the parent already has the answer. Preventing Low-Balance Disruptions The more disruptive scenario isn't the balance inquiry call — it's the student who arrives at the serving line with an empty or nearly empty account. Handling that situation takes serving line time, creates awkward moments for the student, and requires follow-up contact with the family. Low-balance email alerts address the problem before it reaches the cafeteria. When a parent sets a low-balance threshold and receives an automatic alert, they have time to add funds before the account is depleted. The link from the alert — or from the balance retrieval portal — goes directly to mymealmoney.com, where they can add funds immediately. The payment imports automatically into MiChoice. By the next meal service, the account is funded. Part of the Complete Online Services Suite Online Meal Account Retrieval is one component of MiChoice's complete suite of online parent services. The Online F&R Application Portal handles eligibility applications digitally. mymealmoney.com handles online payments via RevTrak. Account Retrieval closes the loop by giving parents visibility into the account between application and payment — keeping families informed and engaged without creating work for district staff. Request a Demo ← All Products EZ-Task Inventory Dashboard 300+ Reports 142 98 211 156 73 188 122 Proteins Grains Produce Dairy Canned Frozen Dry Production Linked Auto-depletion on use 300+ Reports · No Manual Extensions · USDA Compliant miInventory (EZ-Task) Inventory 300+ Reports · Automated Reorder · Cost of Goods Tracking 300+ Standard Reports 0 Manual Extensions Required Live Cost of Goods Tracking ∞ Commodity Cross-References Key Features 300+ Standard Reports Every inventory report a child nutrition director needs — item usage, cost of goods, inventory levels, reorder suggestions, and more. Automated Inventory Extension EZ-Task eliminates the manual work of extending inventory counts. Totals are calculated automatically — hours of work reduced to minutes. Item & Quantity Tracking Track every item in your inventory with real-time quantity updates driven by production records and deliveries. Cost of Goods Tracking Know exactly what every item costs, what it costs per serving, and how your food costs are trending — automatically. Suggested Reorder EZ-Task monitors inventory levels and generates suggested reorder reports before items run out — preventing shortages without overstocking. Commodity Cross-References Full commodity item cross-referencing to track USDA commodity foods alongside purchased items in a unified inventory. Purchasing & Receiving Purchase order management and delivery receiving built in — inventory updates automatically on receipt confirmation. Production Depletion Production records automatically deplete inventory items as meals are prepared — no manual entry, no end-of-period reconciliation. Multi-Location Support Manage inventory across multiple schools and warehouses from one system — with site-specific and district-aggregate views. Ending the Inventory Extension Problem If you're still doing inventory the old way — counting items, writing them on paper, then manually calculating extensions and totals — EZ-Task will transform how your program operates. Inventory time is cut dramatically. The time spent extending inventory is eliminated completely. Child nutrition directors can track items and quantities, produce the reports they need for government compliance, and manage their lunchroom inventory with confidence — without the hours of administrative burden that used to define end-of-period inventory work. The Report Library With 300+ standard reports, EZ-Task covers every inventory management scenario your program will encounter — cost of goods summaries, inventory level snapshots, item usage trends, suggested reorder lists, commodity cross-reference reports, purchasing history, and more. All of these are pre-built and available on demand — no custom report configuration required for standard functions. Production Integration EZ-Task closes the loop between production and inventory automatically. When production data is recorded — actual quantities prepared — those quantities automatically deplete the corresponding inventory items in EZ-Task. No manual entry. No reconciliation at period end. The inventory is always current. timeandattendancesoftware.text: miTimes (ETC) Time & Attendance | MiChoice Technology Systems Home › Products › miTimes (ETC) Time & Attendance miTimes (ETC) Time & Attendance Software ETC converts any computer in your food service operation — including the cafeteria POS terminal — into a fully functional employee time clock. Time card preparation is automated, gross wages are calculated, and workforce management becomes a function that takes minutes instead of hours. Request a Demo ← All Products 7:48 AM ETC Time Cards M. Roberts IN 07:32 J. Williams IN 07:45 T. Garcia IN 07:51 P. Chen OUT 12:02 D. Lewis IN 08:03 Weekly Gross Wages $2,847.50 Hours This Period 186.5 hrs Any PC · Auto Time Cards · Gross Wages miTimes (ETC) Time & Attendance Any PC · Automated Time Cards · Gross Wages Calculated Key Features Use Existing Hardware ETC runs on any PC — including your existing eMeal POS terminal. No dedicated time clock hardware required. Automated Time Cards Time card preparation is fully automated from punch data. The manual process of calculating and completing time cards is eliminated. Gross Wages Calculation ETC calculates gross wages from time punch data and pay rates — giving managers accurate payroll information without manual calculation. Centralized Employee Database All employee records, schedules, and time history maintained in a single centralized database — accessible from any authorized terminal. Time Clock Punch Tracking Every clock in and clock out is timestamped and recorded. Missed punches and exceptions are flagged for manager review. Attendance Reporting Comprehensive attendance reports — daily summaries, exception reports, overtime tracking, absence patterns — available on demand. Easy for Staff The employee-facing interface is simple and intuitive — designed for cafeteria staff, not office workers. Minimal training required. Management Reporting Directors have the workforce data they need to make accurate staffing decisions — right at their fingertips, updated in real time. Time Is Money — Literally School food service operations run on precise staffing. Too many staff on a light service day is an unnecessary cost. Too few on a heavy day affects service quality. And the administrative burden of tracking time and preparing payroll records consumes manager time that should go to operations. ETC addresses all three problems. By automating time card preparation and gross wages calculation, it gives the time back to managers. By maintaining precise punch-level records, it gives directors the data they need to right-size staffing. And by using existing hardware — the POS terminal or any available PC — it delivers this functionality without a hardware investment. Using Your Existing Infrastructure One of ETC's most practical advantages is its hardware flexibility. It runs on any Windows PC — including the eMeal POS terminal that's already deployed at the cafeteria serving line. Staff clock in and out at the same station they use for meal service. No separate time clock kiosk required, no additional hardware cost, no additional training on unfamiliar equipment. The Reporting Advantage Beyond time card automation, ETC's reporting suite gives food service directors visibility they typically don't have. Overtime alerts before overtime becomes a budget problem. Absence patterns before they become scheduling problems. Actual labor hours versus budgeted hours across the district. The information needed to manage a food service workforce accurately. aboutus.text: About Us | MiChoice Technology Systems About MiChoice One Industry. One Focus. 35 Years of Proof. Our staff brings over 35 years of hands-on school food service technology experience. At MiChoice, we work with client school districts to create unique solutions that combine best-of-breed software and hardware with disciplined project management and the kind of ongoing help desk support that's genuinely unequaled in this industry. The result is a deep, collaborative partnership that translates into real return on investment — not just a software license. ◆ K-12 Exclusive We serve one industry. We approach every engagement as an integrated challenge — technology, process, people, and support. ◆ Microsoft Platform Built on Microsoft development tools — the same infrastructure your district already relies on. No exotic dependencies. No proprietary lock-in beyond what's necessary. ◆ Affordable by Design K-12 food service programs run on tight budgets. First-rate software shouldn't require enterprise-level contracts. We've always priced for districts, not for Wall Street. ◆ On-Site Partnership We don't mail you software and wish you luck. Every deployment is backed by on-site installation, hands-on training, and a support team that picks up the phone. ◆ Compliance Built In USDA regulations, NSLP requirements, and government reporting are baked into every module — not bolted on as an afterthought or left to the district to configure.
